problem:
Problem description
- There are products indexed by $$p \in \mathcal{P}$$, workshops indexed by $$w \in \mathcal{W}$$, and planning periods indexed by $$t \in \mathcal{T}$$.
- Each product $$p$$ requires a specified amount of workshop time in each workshop $$w$$ before it can be completed and sold; these processing requirements are given by $$a_{p,w}$$.
- Each unit of product $$p$$ incurs a post-production inspection and sales cost given by $$c^{\mathrm{ps}}_{p}$$.
- Each workshop $$w$$ has regular available production hours in each period $$t$$, represented by $$H_{w,t}$$, and each hour used in that workshop has an operating cost given by $$c^{\mathrm{hr}}_{w}$$.
- Some workshops may allow overtime; if overtime is permitted in workshop $$w$$, the overtime usage in period $$t$$ is limited by $$O^{\max}_{w,t}$$.
- Minimum sales requirements or demand targets are given by $$d_{p,t}$$ for each product and period.
- The planning goal is to determine a feasible periodic production-and-sales plan that satisfies all stated business rules.
- Required business constraints, stated in words:
  - The total inspection and sales cost in each period must not exceed the available budget $$B_t$$.
  - The sold quantity of each product in each period must meet at least the required minimum demand.
  - The production plan must respect the processing time requirements of every workshop for every product.
  - The regular available hours in each workshop must be fully utilized in every period.
  - Overtime, where allowed, must not exceed its corresponding limit.
  - The number of units sold in a period cannot exceed the number of units produced and processed in that period.
- A solution is represented by:
  - $$x_{p,t}$$: the number of units of product $$p$$ produced in period $$t$$.
  - $$s_{p,t}$$: the number of units of product $$p$$ sold in period $$t$$ after inspection and sales procedures.
  - $$u_{w,t}$$: the regular hours used in workshop $$w$$ during period $$t$$.
  - $$o_{w,t}$$: the overtime hours used in workshop $$w$$ during period $$t$$.
  - $$Z$$: the resulting total operating cost, if the planning criterion includes cost evaluation.

Input Format
{
  "P": "integer $$|\mathcal{P}|$$, number of products",
  "W": "integer $$|\mathcal{W}|$$, number of workshops",
  "T": "integer $$|\mathcal{T}|$$, number of planning periods",
  "product_ids": "array of length $$P$$ listing product identifiers for $$p \in \mathcal{P}$$",
  "workshop_ids": "array of length $$W$$ listing workshop identifiers for $$w \in \mathcal{W}$$",
  "period_ids": "array of length $$T$$ listing period identifiers for $$t \in \mathcal{T}$$",
  "processing_time": "matrix $$a_{p,w}$$ of shape $$P \\times W$$; required workshop time per unit of product $$p$$ in workshop $$w$$",
  "unit_post_processing_cost": "vector $$c^{\\mathrm{ps}}_{p}$$ of length $$P$$; inspection and sales cost per unit of product $$p$$",
  "regular_capacity": "matrix $$H_{w,t}$$ of shape $$W \\times T$$; regular available hours in workshop $$w$$ during period $$t$$",
  "hour_cost": "vector $$c^{\\mathrm{hr}}_{w}$$ of length $$W$$; operating cost per hour in workshop $$w$$",
  "minimum_sales": "matrix $$d_{p,t}$$ of shape $$P \\times T$$; minimum required sold units of product $$p$$ in period $$t$$",
  "post_processing_budget": "vector $$B_t$$ of length $$T$$; maximum allowed inspection and sales cost in period $$t$$",
  "overtime_limit": "matrix $$O^{\\max}_{w,t}$$ of shape $$W \\times T$$; maximum overtime allowed in workshop $$w$$ during period $$t$$",
  "overtime_allowed": "subset of workshops $$\\mathcal{W}^{\\mathrm{ot}} \\subseteq \\mathcal{W}$$ where overtime may be used"
}

Output Format
{
  "production": "matrix $$x_{p,t}$$ of shape $$P \\times T$$; produced quantity of each product in each period",
  "sales": "matrix $$s_{p,t}$$ of shape $$P \\times T$$; sold quantity of each product in each period",
  "regular_work_hours_used": "matrix $$u_{w,t}$$ of shape $$W \\times T$$; regular workshop hours used in each period",
  "overtime_hours_used": "matrix $$o_{w,t}$$ of shape $$W \\times T$$; overtime hours used in each period",
  "total_cost": "$$Z$$; total operating cost associated with the returned plan, if reported"
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "P": 2,
  "W": 2,
  "T": 1,
  "product_ids": ["microwave_oven", "water_heater"],
  "workshop_ids": ["A", "B"],
  "period_ids": ["month_1"],
  "processing_time": [[2, 1], [1, 3]],
  "unit_post_processing_cost": [30, 50],
  "regular_capacity": [[250], [150]],
  "hour_cost": [80, 20],
  "minimum_sales": [[80], [50]],
  "post_processing_budget": [5500],
  "overtime_limit": [[20], [0]],
  "overtime_allowed": ["A"]
}

parameters.name: product_count
parameters.description: Number of products in the planning set

parameters.name: workshop_count
parameters.description: Number of workshops in the planning set

parameters.name: product_ids
parameters.description: Identifiers of products indexed by product position

parameters.name: workshop_ids
parameters.description: Identifiers of workshops indexed by workshop position

parameters.name: period_ids
parameters.description: Identifiers of planning periods indexed by period position

parameters.name: processing_time
parameters.description: Processing time required in workshop w per unit of product p

parameters.name: unit_post_processing_cost
parameters.description: Post-production inspection and sales cost per unit of product p

parameters.name: regular_capacity
parameters.description: Regular available hours in workshop w during period t

parameters.name: hour_cost
parameters.description: Operating cost per regular hour in workshop w

parameters.name: minimum_sales
parameters.description: Minimum required sold quantity of product p in period t

parameters.name: post_processing_budget
parameters.description: Maximum allowed inspection and sales budget in period t

parameters.name: overtime_limit
parameters.description: Maximum overtime allowed in workshop w during period t

parameters.name: overtime_allowed
parameters.description: Subset of workshops where overtime is permitted

variables.name: production
variables.description: Number of units of product p produced in period t

variables.name: sales
variables.description: Number of units of product p sold in period t

variables.name: regular_work_hours_used
variables.description: Regular hours used in workshop w during period t

variables.name: overtime_hours_used
variables.description: Overtime hours used in workshop w during period t

variables.name: total_cost
variables.description: Total operating cost associated with the plan

constraints.name: minimum_sales_target
constraints.description: Sold quantity for each product and period must meet the minimum required sales target

constraints.name: production_processing_requirement
constraints.description: Total workshop load induced by production must not exceed the hours available from regular and overtime usage in each workshop and period
constraints.formula: \sum_{p=1}^{P} a_{p,w} x_{p,t} \leq u_{w,t} + o_{w,t} \quad \forall w,\; \forall t

constraints.name: regular_capacity_fully_used
constraints.description: Regular available hours in each workshop and period are fully utilized

constraints.name: overtime_capacity_limit
constraints.description: Overtime hours in each workshop and period cannot exceed the overtime limit

constraints.name: overtime_only_where_allowed
constraints.description: Overtime must be zero for workshops that are not in the overtime-allowed subset

constraints.name: sales_cannot_exceed_production
constraints.description: Sales in a period cannot exceed the number of units produced and processed in the same period

constraints.name: total_cost_definition
constraints.description: Total operating cost aggregates the relevant plan cost components when reported

objectives.name: find_feasible_plan
objectives.description: Find any feasible periodic production-and-sales plan satisfying all stated constraints; report total operating cost if needed

final_objective.description: This is a feasibility problem: find any periodic production-and-sales plan satisfying all stated constraints, with total cost reported through an accounting variable rather than optimized.
